Get moving with this 30 minute beginner walk at home workout designed to help you improve your cardio fitness, burn calories, and build endurance—all without leaving your house. This low-impact walking workout is perfect for beginners, adults over 50, or anyone looking for an enjoyable way to stay active.
Want an extra challenge? Grab a pair of optional hand weights to increase the intensity and add light upper-body strengthening while you walk. Use the weights only if they feel comfortable—this workout is effective with or without them.
